reason: Honestly my mess of apps is exactly the problem this says it fixes, so I'd download the free one and mess around with a workout log. But I'm not paying $6 a month on my budget until it's proven it can actually replace stuff I already have for free.
objection: All my class notes, my budget spreadsheet and my gym history already live in other apps. Moving all that over sounds like a weekend I don't have, and if I only move half of it I've just got a sixth app.
would_change_my_mind: If it could pull in my existing notes and workout history from the apps I already use, for free, in a few minutes, so switching costs me nothing.
